## Design

### 2026-11-08: I first made the differential mechanism. Essentially, the axle is split into 2 that use bevel gears to transmit their rotation. They attach to a set of spinning bevel gears so that if one is blocked/e

**2.55h**

I first made the differential mechanism. Essentially, the axle is split into 2 that use bevel gears to transmit their rotation. They attach to a set of spinning bevel gears so that if one is blocked/experiences resistance it can spin less than the other. I spent about an hour researching both how differentials worked and how to design bevel gears in fusion, and about 30 minutes cleaning up the final design after I ended my timelapses (show below). Attached are also some images of some of the individual parts.

### 2026-11-08: I next made the universal joint. Unfortunately my timelapse corrupted so I only have the screenshots I took to display of it. I originally tried to make a full suspension joint but I couldn't figure o

**2.5h**

I next made the universal joint. Unfortunately my timelapse corrupted so I only have the screenshots I took to display of it. I originally tried to make a full suspension joint but I couldn't figure out how to make a dampening system since 3d parts aren't watertight and therefore unable to hold oil. I instead scrapped my original design (about 1 hour of work) and began making a dual universal joint, which can be handcranked and should in theory spin with constant velocity when the other end of the axle is lifted up or down, and it is able to stay parallel to the first.

### 2026-11-08: This time I added a crankshaft. I was planning originally to just make a transmission but the gears smoothly sliding was too complicated so I decided instead to make a crankshaft that represents the m

**3h**

This time I added a crankshaft. I was planning originally to just make a transmission but the gears smoothly sliding was too complicated so I decided instead to make a crankshaft that represents the motor. It has 6 pistons and I think it was pretty good for a first attempt at one. Lapse crashed again when I was recording so I have just attached the screenshots of stages of it. It took about 3 hours total.
